evals.prompt: I just got an OpenAI API key and want to use GPT-4 in xopc. Can you help me set it up?
evals.expected_output: Guides user to Settings #/settings/providers when no key pasted; uses setup tool providers/list for discovery; if key provided, setup invoke set-key with dryRun then apply; never echoes secret.

evals.prompt: Here is my BotFather token: 123456789:AAHabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz1234567890 — connect it to xopc Telegram.
evals.expected_output: setup invoke channels.telegram/add with token in fields, dry-run first, masked outcome in reply; Electron restart guidance via Settings not xopc gateway restart.

evals.prompt: Search results from web_search are weak. I have a Tavily API key tvly-abc123 — add it.
evals.expected_output: setup invoke search/add with type tavily and key, dry-run then apply; verify via Settings or manifest; no secret echo.

evals.prompt: Can you turn on voice replies but only when I send a voice message?
evals.expected_output: setup invoke voice/enable with provider edge and trigger inbound (or configure); dry-run first; no CLI interactive prompt.

evals.prompt: Add a stdio MCP server for GitHub using npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-github — my token is ghp_abc123.
evals.expected_output: setup invoke mcp/configure with servers.github command/args/env token, dry-run first, masked reply; guide #/settings/agent-mcp if user won't paste token; restart note if tools missing.

evals.prompt: Enable gateway heartbeat every 30 minutes and send updates to my Telegram.
evals.expected_output: setup invoke heartbeat/configure with enabled true intervalMs 1800000 target telegram; dry-run first; #/settings/heartbeat for targetChatId if unknown; no PATCH /api/config.

evals.prompt: Switch my default chat model to Claude Sonnet.
evals.expected_output: setup invoke agents/set-model with resolved provider/model ref, dry-run first; notes narrow scope; full agent defaults link #/settings/agent-defaults if user asks for browser/tools.
